name: Sutekh Dune Eclipse
loreTies: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
Solar Law: coordinated Titans gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
Sutekh Dune Eclipse is a colossal Aten Ra Titan shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Sutekh, Red Land Storm God, is one of the four playable god-Titans of the Aten Ra canon. The lore remains the same; the playable form is now the source-realm divinity behind the mythology: desert storm god, chaos-breaker who defends the sun barque against worse chaos.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Sutekh Dune Eclipse began as more than a weapon in The Golden Dominion of Aten. Sutekh Dune Eclipse was bound to a solar pylon during a Gate disturbance that tested whether sacred order channels solar power into civilization could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Aten Ra, Sutekh Dune Eclipse is treated as proof that a divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms, but their real identity is tactical: defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Sutekh Dune Eclipse; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Sutekh Dune Eclipse survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever judgment zones appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Sutekh Dune Eclipse gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-Titan Titan, Sutekh Dune Eclipse turns Solar Law from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Sutekh Dune Eclipse's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 40, attack 6, range 3, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Mesha and other Codex witnesses can interpret their Gate scar.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: Set/Sutekh + Red Land desert storms + defender against chaos
visualCanon: Disruptor Titan with red desert jasper armor, storm-sand erosion, eclipse-black solar disc behind a sharp Set-like threshold mask, hooked khopesh energy arcs, ragged gold linen, and violent asymmetry controlled by Ma’at bands. Must look dangerous and necessary, not a generic demon or villain robot.
